title: Mamdani unveils $290m plan to close Rikers Island by 2032, five years past legal deadline
summary_full: In a bold move, New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani has unveiled a strategic initiative aimed at closing Rikers Island jail by 2032. The plan emphasizes the establishment of four smaller jails across various boroughs, with a focus on slashing the jail population. Key investments in mental health services and job training are central to this effort, as the city seeks to reform the beleaguered jail system.
